name: When evidence meets rank

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic Alliance quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Shaw doubts that evidence against a connected noble will readily bring justice through ordinary channels. He sends the investigator to Elling Trias, placing the next step outside the formal report he has just described. This is Shaw’s judgment, not a universal statement about Stormwind law, and the story does not conceal the cost of taking the extralegal path.
